decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program has its own page, required staffing and regulatory investment, and is central to the firm's psychiatric direction, so management will attribute any weak uptake to ramp-up and persist.

The carpentry workshop carries sunk equipment costs and visible commitment through its own page, and it supports the participation mission of the sheltered workshop, so management will justify continuing it even after the retail shop was closed.
The senior living counseling service is shown on the home page, which signals strong public commitment, and it is cheap to run and central to the eldercare direction, so dropping it is unlikely.

The meal delivery service launched only in 2024, so disappointing results can still be attributed to start-up effects, although its low visibility as a mere mention makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible.
